title: Headless TTW Into The Pitt (DLC01Quest01): from Wernher's broadcast through the raiders at the radio tower, the slave outfit, the hand cart through the tunnel and Wernher's farewell to Mex at the gate and the slavers downtown (stage 200, quest completed)

actions.text: Starts with the player out of Vault 101 (the given): Escape! (CG04) done at stage 200, whose script starts Following in His Footsteps (MQ01 stage 10) and Trouble on the Homefront (MS16). [observed: CG04 stage 200 script]

The add-on's trigger: DLC01Quest01 is start-game enabled and DLC01Quest01SCRIPT [observed] starts Wernher's broadcast 30 seconds after the Enclave Radio station (RadioEnclaveREF) is enabled, or once MQ09 reaches 60. Stand-in for the main quest turning Enclave Radio on: the station is enabled here; the script then sets DLC01Quest01 10 (Find the source of the radio transmissions) and shows the add-on's message.

Travel stand-in: following the broadcast to the radio tower, where raiders have Wernher cornered (DLC01RadioTowerSceneTriggerSCRIPT [observed] sets them on him and the player). The player kills the three raiders.

actions.label: wernher: you've come about the broadcast
milestone: DLC01Quest01 50, acquire a slave outfit

actions.text: Stand-in for the slavers' camp: the player takes a slave outfit (the outfit's DLC01SlaveOutfitSCRIPT [observed], in the player's inventory with stage 50 done, sets stage 90; stage 90 moves Wernher to the camp).

actions.label: milestone: DLC01Quest01 100, travel to The Pitt

actions.text: Travel stand-in: to the railway tunnel with Wernher. The hand cart (DLC01TunnelHandcartDCSCRIPT [observed]: with Wernher within 500 units and stage 100, its message box's second button starts the ride) takes both to The Pitt's travel markers 5 seconds on.

The arrival ambush: the player steps off the cart into DLC01AmbushStartTRIG (its script [observed]: Wernher's travel to the raiders, CheckIfPlayerShoots 1), Wernher talks to DC01RaiderAmbushLeaderREF and a shot starts the fight (DLC01AmbushControlTRIG's script [observed]). Four raiders, then a second wave of three (enabled when four are dead); at seven WernherShootAt goes to 0 and Wernher's package is re-evaluated: DLC01WernerEscortFirstGate leads the player to the first gate, Wernher's own locked fence gate (PittFenceGateRef, owned by DLC01Wernher [observed: its XOWN]), past which lies the arrival trigger.

Stepping off the cart the player walks into DLC01PittArrivalTrigger (its script [observed]: Wernher's WernherGreetPlayerAtGate 1, his package re-evaluated); Wernher's farewell at the bridge sets stage 150 (Infiltrate The Pitt).

actions.label: wernher: this is as far as I can go (stage 150)

actions.text: The player puts the slave outfit on and walks over the bridge to the Pitt's gate: the gate's trigger (DLC01FrontGateEnterTriggerSCRIPT, TTW's [observed]) shuts the gate and has Mex call the player over; the gas-valve trigger beyond (DLC01MarketSquareGateTriggerSCRIPT) opens it (PittGateOpen 1). Mex takes the player for a runaway slave: his greeting's begin script strips the player's gear into DLC01PlayerItemContainerREF and opens the way in.

Travel stand-in: through the gate into downtown, where a slaver is beating slaves (the FF006 scene): its trigger (DLC01FF006TriggerScript, TTW's [observed]) sets stage 199, which sets 200 and starts Unsafe Working Conditions (DLC01Quest02 10).
